summary.name: Alfred 5
summary.one_liner: Alfred is a macOS productivity launcher for opening apps, searching files and the web, clipboard history, text snippets, and automation workflows, with a core that is free and a paid Powerpack for extras.
use_cases: launch apps and find files without using the mouse
expand short abbreviations into longer text snippets
control music playback and system commands
search the web with custom keyword shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: Alfred is a launcher for macOS that opens apps and finds files on the Mac or the web, learning usage over time to rank results. It uses hotkeys and keywords to trigger searches, file previews (via the Shift key), quick maths, spelling and dictionary lookups, and system commands such as sleep or emptying the Trash. Clipboard History stores past copied text, images, file paths and hex colour codes for re-pasting, and Snippets expand abbreviations into longer text. The Powerpack adds workflows, which link hotkeys, keywords and actions together without code, and includes integrations for Music.app, Contacts, Terminal and 1Password.
notable: Core launcher free to use forever; Powerpack unlocks workflows, themes and advanced features
Clipboard History and Snippets with text expansion
Workflows can be built without code and imported from community-shared ones
Alfred Remote turns an iPhone or iPad into a command centre for the Mac
caveats: Workflows, themes and several features require the paid Powerpack
Alfred Remote for iOS is a separate purchase
